sec01-card-sec01-F11.question_text: Which supplemental forms must international students and exchange visitors bring, and what accompanies travel, parole, or judge orders?
sec01-card-sec01-F11.teaching_text: Showing a standalone school or parole form without your unexpired foreign passport stalls counter verification.

sec01-card-sec01-F12.question_text: What interim credential can a non-citizen receive while federal and state agencies verify submitted records, and what if checks fail?
sec01-card-sec01-F12.teaching_text: That temporary paper bridges database review windows yet cancels into denial if federal records mismatch.

sec01-card-sec01-F13.question_text: Which five documents are accepted to prove and verify an applicant's Social Security number?
sec01-card-sec01-F13.teaching_text: Paystubs that mask digits with asterisks get rejected when a full-number document is needed.

sec01-card-sec01-F14.question_text: Who must present one secondary identification item instead of a Social Security proof, and what kinds of records qualify?
sec01-card-sec01-F14.teaching_text: Every non-immigrant and anyone never issued a Social Security number backs up primary identity this way.

sec01-card-sec01-F15.question_text: How many residential address proofs are required, and which everyday household, vehicle, or insurance records count?
sec01-card-sec01-F15.teaching_text: Picking two distinct billing, lease, or registration records confirms your physical Florida street address.

sec01-card-sec01-F16.question_text: Which school, mail, or shelter records also prove address, and what must you add if you live in someone else's home?
sec01-card-sec01-F16.teaching_text: Teens and roommates whose names are off utility bills pair host certification with their host's proofs.

sec01-card-sec01-R06.question_text: Which document formats pass counter inspection, which copies get rejected, and how are name differences resolved?
sec01-card-sec01-R06.teaching_text: Notarizing a plain photocopy does not turn it into a government-certified vital record.

sec01-card-sec01-R07.question_text: Can an applicant blend primary identification documents across citizen, immigrant, Canadian, and non-immigrant lists?
sec01-card-sec01-R07.teaching_text: Pulling one document from each status table fails inspection because each legal category stands alone.

sec01-card-sec01-R08.question_text: How does Florida handle pending document verification versus a failed primary and secondary check?
sec01-card-sec01-R08.teaching_text: Temporary driving authority lasts only while records clear and ends immediately upon an agency mismatch.

sec01-card-sec01-R09.question_text: How does the required count for secondary identification compare with the required count for residential address proof?
sec01-card-sec01-R09.teaching_text: Remembering one backup ID versus two street-address proofs prevents shortchanging your residence folder.

sec01-card-sec01-F17.question_text: What age and test requirements separate getting a Florida learner's license from earning a full driver license?
sec01-card-sec01-F17.teaching_text: Turning sixteen unlocks road-skills testing only after you already cleared learner training and written exams.

sec01-card-sec01-F18.question_text: What five milestones covering hold time, driving record, certified hours, consent, and school must a minor meet for a license?
sec01-card-sec01-F18.teaching_text: Even one moving conviction resets your clean-year clock unless adjudication was formally withheld once.

sec01-card-sec01-F19.question_text: Who must complete Florida's substance-abuse course before getting a first license, and which graduates skip it?
sec01-card-sec01-F19.teaching_text: Adults getting licensed for the very first time still need this course just like teens.

sec01-card-sec01-F20.question_text: How does parental consent work for unmarried minors, and what replaces it for married or emancipated teens?
sec01-card-sec01-F20.teaching_text: Whoever co-signs a minor's application assumes legal crash liability and holds unilateral cancellation power.

sec01-card-sec01-F21.question_text: What health disclosures and physician reports are required at licensing, and what optional medical mark is available?
sec01-card-sec01-F21.teaching_text: Optional insulin-dependent card designations help paramedics respond fast during roadside low-blood-sugar emergencies.

sec01-card-sec01-F22.question_text: What penalties hit drivers who ignore a license restriction, and what conditions do letter codes regulate?
sec01-card-sec01-F22.teaching_text: Driving without required glasses or past a daylight-only code triggers both tickets and license suspension.

sec01-card-sec01-F23.question_text: Which vehicle adaptations, medical alerts, and route limits are governed by numbered restriction codes?
sec01-card-sec01-F23.teaching_text: Examiners assign numbered codes whenever safe control depends on ignition interlocks, automatic transmissions, or steering knobs.

sec01-card-sec01-R10.question_text: How does the age-fifteen learner package expand when stepping up to full licensure at sixteen?
sec01-card-sec01-R10.teaching_text: Road maneuvers wait until sixteen after your vision and traffic-law foundations are already proven.

sec01-card-sec01-R11.question_text: Who can certify a minor's fifty driving hours, and how do convictions, school attendance, and age eighteen affect the upgrade?
sec01-card-sec01-R11.teaching_text: Skipping classes or stacking moving tickets blocks your upgrade just as surely as unlogged night hours.

sec01-card-sec01-R12.question_text: Which specific credential lets a first-time Florida license seeker bypass the standalone substance-abuse course?
sec01-card-sec01-R12.teaching_text: Approved high-school driver education already folds drug-and-alcohol curriculum into its graduation certificate.

sec01-card-sec01-R13.question_text: What legal power does a consenting adult retain over a minor's license, and which minors apply without adult consent?
sec01-card-sec01-R13.teaching_text: Court emancipation or marriage legally transfers full adult responsibility onto the teen applicant.

sec01-card-sec01-R14.question_text: What extra destinations are allowed on a business-purpose restriction compared with an employment-only restriction?
sec01-card-sec01-R14.teaching_text: Permit exams love testing that business-purpose hardship covers essential life errands beyond commuting to work.

sec01-card-sec01-F24.question_text: At what age do Florida ID cards begin, how long do they last, can you hold one alongside a license, and who gets one free?
sec01-card-sec01-F24.teaching_text: Florida forbids holding an active driver license and state ID card at the same time.

sec01-card-sec01-F25.question_text: How quickly and where must registered career offenders report for card issuance and later updates?
sec01-card-sec01-F25.teaching_text: Online portals never satisfy this mandate because every initial filing and change requires in-person appearance.

sec01-card-sec01-F26.question_text: Which male age bracket faces Selective Service registration at licensing, and what deadline binds sexual offenders and predators?
sec01-card-sec01-F26.teaching_text: Unlike business-day rules, the forty-eight-hour clock runs straight through weekends and holidays.

sec01-card-sec01-F27.question_text: How do the printed designations differ between sexual offender and sexual predator cards, and how fast must changes be reported?
sec01-card-sec01-F27.teaching_text: Both card markings trigger mandatory forty-eight-hour reporting whenever residence or legal name changes.

sec01-card-sec01-F28.question_text: Which three optional designations or charitable contributions can applicants add during licensing?
sec01-card-sec01-F28.teaching_text: Showing qualifying honorable-discharge records adds the Veteran designation without any extra designation charge.

sec01-card-sec01-R15.question_text: How do Florida ID expiration terms split by age, and why must you surrender an ID when getting licensed?
sec01-card-sec01-R15.teaching_text: State records permit only a single active credential per person, either license or ID.

sec01-card-sec01-R16.question_text: How does the reporting clock for career offenders differ from the clock for sexual offenders and predators?
sec01-card-sec01-R16.teaching_text: Weekend closures extend working-day deadlines slightly, whereas forty-eight hours counts continuous elapsed time.

sec01-card-sec01-R17.question_text: How do offender and predator card markings differ, and can a post-office box serve as a registered home address?
sec01-card-sec01-R17.teaching_text: Listing a mailbox rental instead of an actual sleeping address violates mandatory residence verification.

sec01-card-sec01-F29.question_text: Within how many days must you update your license after moving, and which legal records back a name change?
sec01-card-sec01-F29.teaching_text: Keeping your residential address current ensures court notices and renewal reminders reach the right mailbox.

sec01-card-sec01-F30.question_text: Which federal or foreign agencies must update your new name first before Florida prints a renamed credential?
sec01-card-sec01-F30.teaching_text: State computers cross-check federal name files live, so arriving before updating Social Security blocks printing.

sec01-card-sec01-F31.question_text: How can you replace a missing Florida license, and what waives the replacement fee when your wallet is stolen?
sec01-card-sec01-F31.teaching_text: Bringing an official law-enforcement theft report spares victims from paying the standard replacement charge.

sec01-card-sec01-F32.question_text: Which issue-date cutoff requires bringing a full REAL ID document set again, and how must non-immigrants renew or replace?
sec01-card-sec01-F32.teaching_text: Non-immigrant credentials tie directly to updated visa expiration dates that clerks verify face-to-face.

sec01-card-sec01-F33.question_text: How long does a Class E license stay valid, what two things happen at renewal, and what four problems block renewal?
sec01-card-sec01-F33.teaching_text: Even one unpaid or unanswered traffic ticket freezes license renewal until cleared with the court.

sec01-card-sec01-F34.question_text: When may citizens and immigrants use online renewal, what blocks consecutive online use, and what penalty hits past your birthday?
sec01-card-sec01-F34.teaching_text: Because in-person eye checks must happen periodically, back-to-back convenience renewals online are disallowed.

sec01-card-sec01-F35.question_text: What vision requirement applies to Florida drivers aged eighty and older at every renewal, and what does the state screening cost?
sec01-card-sec01-F35.teaching_text: Older drivers can test free at a service center or submit a licensed eye-doctor report.

sec01-card-sec01-R18.question_text: Why is waiting longer than thirty days to update a Florida address risky for drivers?
sec01-card-sec01-R18.teaching_text: Unopened suspension letters mailed to an old apartment can leave you unknowingly driving suspended.

sec01-card-sec01-R19.question_text: Besides bringing your prior license and passing vision, which four legal or document issues will stop a Class E renewal?
sec01-card-sec01-R19.teaching_text: Resolving open citations and suspensions beforehand saves a wasted trip when your birthday approaches.

sec01-card-sec01-R20.question_text: How does replacing a stolen card with a police report contrast with replacing a card unissued since before twenty-ten?
sec01-card-sec01-R20.teaching_text: Police reports waive fees, whereas pre-modern cards predating twenty-ten trigger full primary-and-address verification.

sec01-card-sec01-R21.question_text: Which groups qualify for Florida's online renewal portal, and which two conditions force an office visit or clearance first?
sec01-card-sec01-R21.teaching_text: Anyone whose last renewal used the web must appear in person next cycle for fresh screening.

sec01-card-sec01-F36.question_text: What are Florida's standard fees for first licenses, learner permits, renewals, replacements, ID cards, and late renewals?
sec01-card-sec01-F36.teaching_text: Renewing before your birthday avoids tacking that extra fifteen-dollar delinquency fee onto forty-eight dollars.

sec01-card-sec01-F37.question_text: What are the six Florida reinstatement fees for fraud, substance offenses, revocation, suspension, general lapses, and bad checks?
sec01-card-sec01-F37.teaching_text: Revocations carry a steeper seventy-five-dollar return fee than standard forty-five-dollar suspensions, while fraud tops all.

sec01-card-sec01-F38.question_text: How does curing a liability-insurance lapse compare with the three escalating PIP lapse fees within three years?
sec01-card-sec01-F38.teaching_text: Canceling Florida coverage before turning in your license plate triggers steep escalating reinstatement tiers.

sec01-card-sec01-F39.question_text: What do written retests, road retests, endorsements, and tax-collector visits cost, and which veterans pay zero credential fees?
sec01-card-sec01-F39.teaching_text: Passing both exams first try saves ten- and twenty-dollar retake charges at county offices.
sec01-card-sec01-F39.must_match_memory_hook: Ten written, twenty skills, veterans free

sec01-card-sec01-R22.question_text: How do the three everyday dollar amounts divide across issuance or renewal, ID or replacement, and late renewal?
sec01-card-sec01-R22.teaching_text: Locking down forty-eight, twenty-five, and fifteen covers nearly every routine counter fee question.

sec01-card-sec01-R23.question_text: How do the reinstatement charges compare across suspension, payment lapses, revocation, and license fraud?
sec01-card-sec01-R23.teaching_text: Notice that unpaid-ticket lapses at sixty dollars actually sit higher than general forty-five-dollar suspensions.

sec01-card-sec01-R24.question_text: Why is a Personal Injury Protection lapse far costlier to cure than a fifteen-dollar liability lapse?
sec01-card-sec01-R24.teaching_text: Repeat no-fault coverage gaps inside thirty-six months jump tenfold from the fifteen-dollar liability fee.

sec01-card-sec01-R25.question_text: How does the knowledge retake charge compare with the driving-skills retake charge, and who receives free credentials?
sec01-card-sec01-R25.teaching_text: Behind-the-wheel retakes cost double the written retake fee, rewarding thorough practice before booking.

sec03-card-sec03-F01.question_text: Which two insurance coverages must be in place before registering a Florida vehicle, and who gets paid under each?
sec03-card-sec03-F01.teaching_text: Quiz distractors flip these around, forgetting Personal Injury Protection covers your own medical bills regardless of fault.

sec03-card-sec03-F02.question_text: How much of each mandatory insurance coverage must Florida vehicle owners carry continuously, from whom, and where does proof stay?
sec03-card-sec03-F02.teaching_text: Buying out-of-state policies or dropping coverage mid-year fails Florida's continuous licensed-carrier rule even while parked.

sec03-card-sec03-F03.question_text: When does the ninety-day presence rule require Florida coverage, what happens upon a lapse, and what must you turn in before canceling a policy?
sec03-card-sec03-F03.teaching_text: Canceling auto insurance before surrendering your metal tag triggers an automatic state report and up to three years suspended.

sec03-card-sec03-F04.question_text: What happens if an officer stops you without insurance proof in the car, and what reinstatement fee range hits convicted lapses?
sec03-card-sec03-F04.teaching_text: Leaving your insurance card at home forces a courthouse trip, whereas an actual lapse costs up to five hundred dollars.

sec03-card-sec03-F05.question_text: What escalated penalties, license restrictions, fake-card charges, and hearing rights apply once an insurance suspension passes thirty days?
sec03-card-sec03-F05.teaching_text: Showing a doctored insurance card or driving past a month suspended turns paperwork trouble into misdemeanor arrest territory.

sec03-card-sec03-F06.question_text: How can crash-involved drivers prove financial responsibility, and what three-year coverage limits hit DUI convictions?
sec03-card-sec03-F06.teaching_text: A single impaired-driving conviction multiplies mandatory liability minimums up to three hundred thousand dollars for three straight years.

sec03-card-sec03-F07.question_text: What bodily-injury and property coverage limits apply after crashes, high point totals, habitual-offender status, or serious offenses?
sec03-card-sec03-F07.teaching_text: Unpaid at-fault crash damages plus dropped elevated coverage lock down your license and plates for up to three years.

sec03-card-sec03-R01.question_text: What is the exact difference between who gets paid by injury coverage versus property damage liability?
sec03-card-sec03-R01.teaching_text: Keep your own medical bills under no-fault protection and damaged fences or bumpers of others under property liability.

sec03-card-sec03-R02.question_text: What dollar minimum applies to standard Florida policies, and what single step prevents a three-year lapse suspension?
sec03-card-sec03-R02.teaching_text: Selling or parking an unused car never stops insurance tracking until the license plate goes back first.

sec03-card-sec03-R03.question_text: How do the consequences differ across forgetting insurance proof, flashing a canceled or fake card, and driving past thirty days suspended?
sec03-card-sec03-R03.teaching_text: Honest forgetfulness gets a court check, whereas flashing known canceled proof invites arrest on the spot.

sec03-card-sec03-R04.question_text: How do three-year DUI financial responsibility limits stack up against crash and point-triggered limits?
sec03-card-sec03-R04.teaching_text: Compare one-hundred and three-hundred thousand under DUI directly against ten and twenty thousand for non-DUI triggers.

sec03-card-sec03-F08.question_text: What supervision and hour limits govern learner-license minors, licensed sixteen-year-olds, and licensed seventeen-year-olds?
sec03-card-sec03-F08.teaching_text: Florida steps night privileges gradually from daylight-only learners up through eleven and one o'clock curfews unless working or supervised.

sec03-card-sec03-F09.question_text: Which seven categories of dishonesty, lending, or misuse count as Florida driver-license crimes?
sec03-card-sec03-F09.teaching_text: Handing your card to a friend or letting an unlicensed buddy borrow your car crosses straight into criminal law.

sec03-card-sec03-F10.question_text: When may a disabled parking permit waive meters or use reserved bays, and what penalties hit borrowing someone else's placard?
sec03-card-sec03-F10.teaching_text: Using a relative's hanging placard while running solo errands risks towing, confiscation, five hundred dollars, or jail.

sec03-card-sec03-R05.question_text: What exact overnight hours restrict licensed sixteen-year-olds versus seventeen-year-olds, and which two exceptions apply?
sec03-card-sec03-R05.teaching_text: Permit questions love testing whether a twenty-year-old passenger excuses curfew when the companion must be twenty-one or older.

sec03-card-sec03-R06.question_text: How do legal disabled-permit benefits contrast with the punishment for using a borrowed placard?
sec03-card-sec03-R06.teaching_text: Reserved bays stay open for mobility needs only because unauthorized borrowers lose the car to a tow truck.

sec03-card-sec03-F11.question_text: Which substances can trigger a DUI, when does arrest-time suspension kick in, and what tests does implied consent cover?
sec03-card-sec03-F11.teaching_text: Signing for a Florida license pre-commits you to breath, urine, or blood checks whenever lawfully arrested for impairment.

sec03-card-sec03-F12.question_text: What license and criminal penalties hit first versus second chemical-test refusals, and what happens in fatal or serious-injury crashes?
sec03-card-sec03-F12.teaching_text: Saying no to a breathalyzer still costs your license immediately and becomes a separate misdemeanor the second time.

sec03-card-sec03-F13.question_text: What fine range, community service, probation, jail cap, revocation window, schooling, and aggravating factors apply to a first DUI?
sec03-card-sec03-F13.teaching_text: Even a first conviction brings mandatory fifty service hours, DUI school, six-month minimum revocation, and steeper child-aboard penalties.

sec03-card-sec03-F14.question_text: How do fines, jail ceilings, DUI school hours, and ignition-interlock time step up on a second DUI conviction?
sec03-card-sec03-F14.teaching_text: Notice ignition interlock shifts from optional to a mandatory full year while DUI school jumps to twenty-one hours.

sec03-card-sec03-F15.question_text: What fine band, jail limit, school hours, and ignition-interlock duration hit a third DUI conviction?
sec03-card-sec03-F15.teaching_text: By a third conviction, fines reach five thousand dollars, jail reaches twelve months, and interlock doubles to two years.

sec03-card-sec03-F16.question_text: What BAL triggers a six-month suspension versus a substance course for drivers under twenty-one, and when are parents notified?
sec03-card-sec03-F16.teaching_text: Just one drink can push an underage driver past point zero two and wipe out driving privileges for six months.

sec03-card-sec03-F17.question_text: What can happen to a vehicle used to transport, sell, or aid a felony drug crime?
sec03-card-sec03-F17.teaching_text: Lending or using a car in felony drug activity lets law enforcement seize and permanently forfeit the vehicle.

sec03-card-sec03-R07.question_text: How wide is Florida's substance definition for DUI, and why can officers compel chemical testing at arrest?
sec03-card-sec03-R07.teaching_text: Over-the-counter cold medicine impairs legally just like alcohol, and your license signature already granted testing consent.

sec03-card-sec03-R08.question_text: How do first refusal, repeat refusal, and serious-injury crash testing rules compare?
sec03-card-sec03-R08.teaching_text: Refusal never shields a driver in a fatal or serious-injury wreck where medical staff draw blood regardless.

sec03-card-sec03-R09.question_text: Which four penalty categories climb steadily across first, second, and third DUI convictions?
sec03-card-sec03-R09.teaching_text: High alcohol readings or a child passenger push penalties even higher on top of each repeat tier.

sec03-card-sec03-R10.question_text: How do point zero two, point zero five, and age nineteen work under Florida's underage alcohol rules?
sec03-card-sec03-R10.teaching_text: Don't mix adult point zero eight with underage point zero two, one of the most tested numbers statewide.

sec03-card-sec03-F18.question_text: What weight threshold separates a civil litter fine from a criminal misdemeanor with points in Florida?
sec03-card-sec03-F18.teaching_text: Dumping over fifteen pounds jumps from a hundred-dollar ticket to a thousand-dollar misdemeanor, cleanup duty, and three license points.

sec03-card-sec03-F19.question_text: What penalties hit illegal school-bus passing, and how severely do they jump when passing on the exit side or causing serious injury?
sec03-card-sec03-F19.teaching_text: Passing a stopped school bus carries mandatory driver school and four points, jumping to a year suspended if someone gets hurt.

sec03-card-sec03-F20.question_text: Why is rim driving banned, how must seat belts cross your body alongside airbags, and where should children under thirteen sit?
sec03-card-sec03-F20.teaching_text: Tucking a shoulder strap behind your back invites severe injury because front airbags only work safely alongside proper belts.

sec03-card-sec03-F21.question_text: Who must buckle up in Florida, how are children through age five restrained, and who gets ticketed for unbuckled minors versus adults?
sec03-card-sec03-F21.teaching_text: Drivers take the ticket for every unbuckled passenger under eighteen, while unbelted adults eighteen and up get cited personally.

sec03-card-sec03-F22.question_text: Which seven specific medical, occupational, vehicle-weight, or emergency situations are exempt from standard belt or booster rules?
sec03-card-sec03-F22.teaching_text: Notice the truck exemption starts above twenty-six thousand pounds, so everyday pickups and vans never qualify.

sec03-card-sec03-R11.question_text: How do fines, criminal status, and license points shift once roadway litter exceeds fifteen pounds?
sec03-card-sec03-R11.teaching_text: Even trash tossed from a window can put three points on your driving record once weight crosses fifteen pounds.

sec03-card-sec03-R12.question_text: How does standard illegal school-bus passing compare with passing a bus and seriously hurting someone?
sec03-card-sec03-R12.teaching_text: Serious injury adds one hundred twenty service hours, a victim panel, a full year suspended, and fifteen hundred dollars.

sec03-card-sec03-R13.question_text: Why must seat belts cross both hips and chest even with airbags, and which age group belongs in the back seat?
sec03-card-sec03-R13.teaching_text: Front passenger airbags inflate with explosive force tuned for belted adults, making the back row safest under age thirteen.

sec03-card-sec03-R14.question_text: What restraint rules govern ages zero through three versus four and five, and how does ticket responsibility split?
sec03-card-sec03-R14.teaching_text: Permit exams frequently pair age five booster rules with testing whether the driver or passenger pays the fine.

sec03-card-sec03-R15.question_text: Which vehicle types and job roles qualify for Florida's narrow seat-belt exemptions?
sec03-card-sec03-R15.teaching_text: Unless delivering newspapers or driving farm gear, buses, or twenty-six-thousand-pound rigs, every front occupant buckles.

sec03-card-sec03-F23.question_text: What is the highest posted highway speed limit in Florida, and what two consequences hit speeders?
sec03-card-sec03-F23.teaching_text: Even on open rural interstates, Florida caps speed at seventy miles per hour and stacks points onto tickets.

sec03-card-sec03-F24.question_text: What mandatory fines hit going fifty miles per hour over the limit, and how are school-zone or work-zone speeders penalized?
sec03-card-sec03-F24.teaching_text: Racing fifty over starts at a thousand dollars and jumps to twenty-five hundred on repeat, while protected zones double fines.

sec03-card-sec03-F25.question_text: Which two crash histories require an at-fault driver to complete a collision-avoidance course?
sec03-card-sec03-F25.teaching_text: Causing an injury sent by ambulance or racking up a second ticketed collision within two years triggers mandatory retraining.

sec03-card-sec03-F26.question_text: What three requirements and deadline hit a driver convicted of three crash-related offenses within thirty-six months?
sec03-card-sec03-F26.teaching_text: Missing that ninety-day window for twelve classroom hours, four behind-the-wheel hours, and an extended exam cancels your license.

sec03-card-sec03-F27.question_text: Which three point-and-month thresholds trigger thirty-day, three-month, and one-year suspensions, and do out-of-state tickets count?
sec03-card-sec03-F27.teaching_text: Tickets earned on road trips outside Florida still post points back home toward those twelve, eighteen, and twenty-four caps.

sec03-card-sec03-F28.question_text: What restriction hits an under-eighteen driver who accumulates six points within twelve months, and how do extra points extend it?
sec03-card-sec03-F28.teaching_text: Just two minor speeding tickets can hit six points and lock a teen into business-purpose-only driving plus ninety-day add-ons.

sec03-card-sec03-F29.question_text: How many points attach to speeding by margin or crash, leaving a damage scene, and texting generally, in school zones, or in crashes?
sec03-card-sec03-F29.teaching_text: Notice any speeding or texting violation that causes a crash rockets straight to six points on your record.

sec03-card-sec03-F30.question_text: What exact point values hit running signals, passing school buses, reckless driving, teen curfew breaches, and zone handheld phone use?
sec03-card-sec03-F30.teaching_text: Breaking teen curfew or holding a phone in a school or work zone quietly stacks three points toward restriction.

sec03-card-sec03-R16.question_text: How do Florida's fifty-over-the-limit penalties compare with speeding through active school or construction zones?
sec03-card-sec03-R16.teaching_text: Protected zones double standard speeding fines up to a thousand dollars to shield children and roadside crews.

sec03-card-sec03-R17.question_text: Within how many days must a three-crash driver finish classroom, behind-the-wheel, and exam retraining to avoid cancellation?
sec03-card-sec03-R17.teaching_text: Letting that ninety-day retraining deadline slip voids your license completely until every requirement gets cleared.

sec03-card-sec03-R18.question_text: How do the twelve, eighteen, and twenty-four adult suspension thresholds contrast with the six-point rule for minors?
sec03-card-sec03-R18.teaching_text: Half the adult twelve-point threshold already restricts an under-eighteen driver to business-only travel for a full year.

sec03-card-sec03-R19.question_text: How do margins over the speed limit, school zones, and crashes step up speeding and texting points?
sec03-card-sec03-R19.teaching_text: Crossing fifteen miles per hour over bumps speeding from three to four points, while any crash hits six.

sec03-card-sec03-R20.question_text: How do Florida's three-point, four-point, and six-point buckets group curfew, signal, reckless, and school-bus violations?
sec03-card-sec03-R20.teaching_text: Grouping violations by point bucket makes permit exam math fast when counting toward six-point or twelve-point limits.

sec03-card-sec03-F31.question_text: Which four dishonesty, misuse, court, or chemical-test grounds immediately trigger a license suspension?
sec03-card-sec03-F31.teaching_text: Even without driving badly on the road, lying on forms or refusing breath testing suspends privileges fast.

sec03-card-sec03-F32.question_text: Which eight financial, school-attendance, point, theft, or compliance failures can also suspend a Florida license?
sec03-card-sec03-F32.teaching_text: Teens are often shocked to learn skipping school classes or missing a traffic ticket deadline suspends their driver license.

sec03-card-sec03-F33.question_text: Which ten serious criminal, medical, or repeat-reckless grounds terminate a license through revocation?
sec03-card-sec03-F33.teaching_text: Unlike a temporary suspension, highway racing, felony vehicle crimes, or three reckless convictions within a year terminate your license.

sec03-card-sec03-F34.question_text: Which three application errors or unfinished requirements cause Florida to cancel a license?
sec03-card-sec03-F34.teaching_text: Cancellation treats a wrongly issued license or skipped required course as invalid until you fix the defect and reapply.

sec03-card-sec03-F35.question_text: Which office handles hardship licenses, how soon after arrest must DUI or refusal appeals be requested, and what option may first offenders choose?
sec03-card-sec03-F35.teaching_text: Wait past ten days after a DUI arrest and your window for an administrative review hearing slams shut.

sec03-card-sec03-R21.question_text: What is the exact legal difference among suspending, revoking, and canceling a Florida driver license?
sec03-card-sec03-R21.teaching_text: Quiz questions test all three definitions side by side: temporary halt, full termination, and voiding an improper issuance.

sec03-card-sec03-R22.question_text: Within what exact post-arrest window must a driver request a review-office hearing for a DUI or test-refusal suspension?
sec03-card-sec03-R22.teaching_text: Keep this ten-day administrative hearing deadline sharp alongside Florida's ten-day newcomer registration rule.

sec04-card-sec04-F01.question_text: Which three parts of you must stay engaged behind the wheel, and what health checkups and medicine checks support safe driving?
sec04-card-sec04-F01.teaching_text: Skipping routine vision or hearing exams or starting a new prescription blind lets hidden impairment creep into everyday drives.

sec04-card-sec04-F02.question_text: What six smart health, eyewear, vehicle, and trip-timing adjustments keep older adults driving safely?
sec04-card-sec04-F02.teaching_text: Wearing tinted lenses at dusk or mixing daily prescriptions cuts contrast and reaction speed right when glare peaks.

sec04-card-sec04-F03.question_text: Which four groups does Florida's safe-mobility-for-life program educate on lifelong travel?
sec04-card-sec04-F03.teaching_text: Planning safe transportation early with family and caregivers keeps older Floridians independent even when driving habits change.

sec04-card-sec04-R01.question_text: What three elements define full driver engagement, and what should starting any new medicine prompt?
sec04-card-sec04-R01.teaching_text: Even one missing piece like a wandering mind or a sedating new pill breaks safe control in traffic.

sec04-card-sec04-R02.question_text: How do medical reviews, exercise, vehicle aids, eyewear choices, and calmer hours work together for older drivers?
sec04-card-sec04-R02.teaching_text: Trading rush-hour freeways and dark sunglasses for daytime errands and regular checkups stretches safe driving years.

sec04-card-sec04-F04.question_text: What are the three types of driving distraction, why is texting uniquely dangerous, and where is handheld phone use illegal?
sec04-card-sec04-F04.teaching_text: Typing a message pulls your eyes, thumbs, and brain off traffic simultaneously while school and work zones ban handhelds completely.

sec04-card-sec04-F05.question_text: Beyond texting, which everyday habits inside or outside the car count as dangerous driver distractions?
sec04-card-sec04-F05.teaching_text: Reaching for dropped fries or rubbernecking at a crash steals seconds of forward sight just like a phone screen.

sec04-card-sec04-R03.question_text: How does each distraction category map to your body, and which single habit triggers every one at once?
sec04-card-sec04-R03.teaching_text: Permit questions love asking why texting tops the danger list: it combines visual, manual, and mental distraction simultaneously.

sec04-card-sec04-R04.question_text: Where in Florida is texting behind the wheel illegal, and which three locations ban holding a phone altogether?
sec04-card-sec04-R04.teaching_text: Watch out for the distinction: texting is outlawed statewide, while simply holding a phone draws tickets inside protected zones.

sec04-card-sec04-F06.question_text: Which mental ability does alcohol impair first before hitting reflexes and vision, and how many drinks leave you safe to drive?
sec04-card-sec04-F06.teaching_text: Because judgment fades before physical coordination, a buzzed person feels confident right as reaction and distance skills slip.

sec04-card-sec04-F07.question_text: How long does a Florida DUI stay on your driving record, what else does it cost, and how do smart riders prevent it?
sec04-card-sec04-F07.teaching_text: Memorize seventy-five years because Florida keeps a DUI conviction on your driving record essentially for life.

sec04-card-sec04-F08.question_text: Why is drowsy driving compared to drunk driving, and what sleep, break-interval, and passenger strategies prevent it?
sec04-card-sec04-F08.teaching_text: Brief involuntary microsleeps black out highway lanes at sixty miles per hour unless you rest and swap drivers.

sec04-card-sec04-R05.question_text: Can years of driving experience keep a single alcoholic drink from impairing your judgment and reflexes?
sec04-card-sec04-R05.teaching_text: Seasoned drivers lose judgment first just like beginners, making zero drinks the only safe pre-drive standard.

sec04-card-sec04-R06.question_text: Why does Florida's record-retention rule make lining up a sober driver or rideshare before drinking essential?
sec04-card-sec04-R06.teaching_text: Choosing your ride home before the first sip costs a few dollars instead of decades of record fallout.

sec04-card-sec04-R07.question_text: What distance and time interval should trigger rest breaks on long Florida drives to prevent microsleep?
sec04-card-sec04-R07.teaching_text: Rolling down windows or blasting music cannot cure microsleep when your brain needs a real break or nap.

sec04-card-sec04-F09.question_text: How do drug-impaired driving penalties compare to alcohol, why is mixing dangerous, and how should legal medicines be checked?
sec04-card-sec04-F09.teaching_text: Combining allergy or pain pills with even a tiny drink multiplies drowsiness far beyond either substance alone.

sec04-card-sec04-F10.question_text: Which strong emotions pull mental focus off the road, and what should you do before turning the key?
sec04-card-sec04-F10.teaching_text: Even positive excitement or heavy sadness narrows your attention tunnel just as dangerously as anger behind the wheel.

sec04-card-sec04-F11.question_text: What behaviors mark road rage, and which four steps protect you if an aggressive driver targets you?
sec04-card-sec04-F11.teaching_text: Locking eyes or gesturing back escalates violent confrontations, so open space, yield the lane, and phone police.

sec04-card-sec04-R08.question_text: What happens legally and physically when drivers ignore warning labels or mix medication with alcohol?
sec04-card-sec04-R08.teaching_text: One drink paired with medication can hit your nervous system like several drinks while carrying full DUI penalties.

sec04-card-sec04-R09.question_text: How does managing your own strong emotions before a drive pair with handling an enraged stranger in traffic?
sec04-card-sec04-R09.teaching_text: You control your own mood before shifting into drive, and you defuse someone else's rage by refusing engagement.

sec05-card-sec05-F01.question_text: What credentials must Florida vehicle owners hold, how soon must newcomers working or enrolling children register, and which out-of-state vehicles skip VIN checks?
sec05-card-sec05-F01.teaching_text: Starting a Florida job or enrolling kids in public school triggers a strict ten-day clock to insure and register.

sec05-card-sec05-F02.question_text: In what order do Florida licensing, titling, and plating run, and how does filing differ between dealership and private sales?
sec05-card-sec05-F02.teaching_text: Buying from a private seller puts the service-center transfer squarely on you, unlike dealerships that handle paperwork.

sec05-card-sec05-F03.question_text: When do standard, mobile-home or semi, and fleet registrations expire, and how early does the renewal window open?
sec05-card-sec05-F03.teaching_text: Standard tags expire right at midnight on the first owner's birthday rather than running through the end of your birth month.

sec05-card-sec05-R01.question_text: How do title proof, the ten-day newcomer rule, and the two-thousand-pound trailer VIN exemption fit together?
sec05-card-sec05-R01.teaching_text: Light utility trailers under two thousand pounds skip physical VIN inspection, while ordinary out-of-state cars never do.

sec05-card-sec05-R02.question_text: How do Florida's three registration expiration dates line up alongside the early-renewal window?
sec05-card-sec05-R02.teaching_text: Renewing up to three months ahead avoids last-minute insurance verification snags on your birthday.

sec05-card-sec05-F04.question_text: What exact beam, tail, brake, plate, signal, horn, mirror, window-tint, and tire-tread numbers must Florida cars meet?
sec05-card-sec05-F04.teaching_text: Watch how low beams illuminate one hundred fifty feet while high beams triple forward reach to four hundred fifty feet.

sec05-card-sec05-F05.question_text: Which colored or extra lights, warning noisemakers, loud or smoky mufflers, and window items are prohibited on Florida cars?
sec05-card-sec05-F05.teaching_text: Blue lamps belong strictly to police and loud aftermarket exhausts heard past fifty feet draw equipment tickets.

sec05-card-sec05-F06.question_text: What cabin screen and audio gear is illegal while driving, where live car-specific answers, and how do airbags relate to belts?
sec05-card-sec05-F06.teaching_text: Video screens visible from the driver's seat pull eyes off traffic, and unbuckled riders hit inflating airbags too early.

sec05-card-sec05-R03.question_text: How do forward illumination and visibility distances compare across low beams, high beams, tail lamps, daytime brake lamps, and plate lights?
sec05-card-sec05-R03.teaching_text: Separate how far headlights light the pavement ahead from the one-thousand-foot distance oncoming drivers spot them.

sec05-card-sec05-R04.question_text: What six equipment rules ban emergency-style lights, extra lamps, noisemakers, noisy exhausts, and window clutter?
sec05-card-sec05-R04.teaching_text: Non-official stickers blocking glass or extra auxiliary lamps beyond two fail Florida's street-legal equipment rules.

sec05-card-sec05-R05.question_text: Why does Florida outlaw driver-view screens and headsets while still requiring belts inside airbag-equipped cars?
sec05-card-sec05-R05.teaching_text: Supplemental airbags are engineered around a belted torso, never as a standalone cushion for unbuckled occupants.

sec05-card-sec05-F07.question_text: Which four hazards do warning-only driver-assistance systems flag, and do they ever brake or steer for you?
sec05-card-sec05-F07.teaching_text: Counting on a lane-departure chime or forward-collision beep to hit the brakes causes wrecks when only alerts exist.

sec05-card-sec05-F08.question_text: Which automatic emergency braking and steering interventions can active assistance systems perform?
sec05-card-sec05-F08.teaching_text: Automatic emergency braking and lane-keeping assist intervene physically when closing speeds or un-signaled drift threaten a crash.

sec05-card-sec05-F09.question_text: How do reverse automatic braking, adaptive cruise, lane centering, and lane keeping each control the vehicle?
sec05-card-sec05-F09.teaching_text: Permit questions test lane centering's continuous middle-holding steering against lane keeping's reactive boundary nudge.

sec05-card-sec05-F10.question_text: What roles do automatic crash notification, automatic high beams, and backup cameras play?
sec05-card-sec05-F10.teaching_text: Wide-angle rear lenses still miss side approaches, so mirrors and shoulder checks remain mandatory every time you back up.

sec05-card-sec05-R06.question_text: What separates warning-only driver aids from active intervention aids?
sec05-card-sec05-R06.teaching_text: Check your car's owner manual before driving so you know whether a blinking icon only chimes or actually brakes.

sec05-card-sec05-R07.question_text: Which exact controls can rear automatic braking, adaptive cruise, lane centering, and lane keeping adjust?
sec05-card-sec05-R07.teaching_text: Notice lane keeping can selectively brake or accelerate individual wheels alongside steering to pull straying tires back.

sec05-card-sec05-R08.question_text: How do crash callers, automatic high beams, and backup cameras assist without replacing attentive driving?
sec05-card-sec05-R08.teaching_text: Rain, glare, or mud on a camera lens or headlight sensor leaves human eyes and mirrors indispensable.

sec05-card-sec05-F11.question_text: How must you press the pedal and steer during an emergency stop with anti-lock brakes, and what mistake disables them?
sec05-card-sec05-F11.teaching_text: Pedal pulsing under your foot means anti-lock electronics are working, whereas lifting or pumping shuts that protection off.

sec05-card-sec05-F12.question_text: How do drivers without anti-lock brakes handle skidding stops, what height band governs bumpers, and what exhaust rule applies?
sec05-card-sec05-F12.teaching_text: Extreme lift kits pushing bumpers past legal twenty-two-to-thirty-inch limits or tampered emission parts fail Florida street law.

sec05-card-sec05-F13.question_text: How do required reflectors and lamps step up between lighter trailers and heavy trailers?
sec05-card-sec05-F13.teaching_text: If a small utility load blocks your tow vehicle's brake lights, the trailer itself must carry a visible stop lamp.

sec05-card-sec05-R09.question_text: What happens if you pump or ease off an anti-lock brake pedal during a panic stop?
sec05-card-sec05-R09.teaching_text: Old manual-pumping instincts defeat modern anti-lock sensors that already pulse brake pressure far faster than your foot.

sec05-card-sec05-R10.question_text: Which three rules govern non-ABS skids, legal bumper heights by vehicle weight, and pollution controls?
sec05-card-sec05-R10.teaching_text: Matching bumper height limits to vehicle weight keeps raised trucks from overriding lower passenger-car frames in crashes.

sec05-card-sec05-R11.question_text: What core lighting distinction separates light utility trailers from heavy trailers at night?
sec05-card-sec05-R11.teaching_text: Wide, heavy trailers need lit corner clearance and side markers so passing drivers judge full trailer length in the dark.

sec05-card-sec05-F14.question_text: How must trailer brakes work from the cab and during a breakaway, and how many stop lamps do trailers need?
sec05-card-sec05-F14.teaching_text: Automatic breakaway braking halts a detached heavy trailer before it rolls uncontrolled across highway lanes.

sec05-card-sec05-F15.question_text: What strength, maximum length, cargo exception, and chain-flag rules apply to towing drawbars and cables?
sec05-card-sec05-F15.teaching_text: Without a bright twelve-inch white square on a tow chain, cross-traffic can mistake two linked cars for an open gap.

sec05-card-sec05-F16.question_text: What standard applies to every hauled load, and what extra restraints secure loose materials versus log trucks?
sec05-card-sec05-F16.teaching_text: Sand, gravel, or yard debris blowing off an uncovered pickup bed draws citations and shatters following windshields.

sec05-card-sec05-F17.question_text: Once cargo extends four feet or more past the rear, what daytime flag, night or rain lights, and log-load strobe are required?
sec05-card-sec05-F17.teaching_text: Long lumber or pipes blend straight into pavement depth perception unless marked by an eighteen-inch red square or five-hundred-foot red lamps.

sec05-card-sec05-F18.question_text: How far may cargo carried on a passenger car extend beyond the left fenders versus the right fenders?
sec05-card-sec05-F18.teaching_text: Zero overhang on the driver's side protects oncoming lanes from clipping cargo, while the curb side allows only six inches.

sec05-card-sec05-R12.question_text: What two braking rules and vintage stop-lamp exception govern towed trailers?
sec05-card-sec05-R12.teaching_text: Only vintage trailers built before nineteen seventy-two may run a single rear stop lamp instead of two.

sec05-card-sec05-R13.question_text: How do the fifteen-foot drawbar limit, twelve-inch white flag, close-fitting tarps, and log lock-chains work together?
sec05-card-sec05-R13.teaching_text: Don't mix the twelve-inch white square on tow chains with the eighteen-inch red square on four-foot rear overhangs.

sec05-card-sec05-R14.question_text: What exact flags, five-hundred-foot lamps, reflectors, and log strobes mark cargo overhanging four feet or more?
sec05-card-sec05-R14.teaching_text: Rain, smoke, and fog trigger the exact same five-hundred-foot red overhang lamps as nighttime sunset-to-sunrise hours.

sec05-card-sec05-R15.question_text: Which side of a passenger car allows zero cargo overhang, and how many inches may extend on the other side?
sec05-card-sec05-R15.teaching_text: Quiz choices often swap left and right or invent twelve inches, so lock down zero left and six right.

sec06-card-sec06-F01.question_text: When may you leave your lane or briefly cross a center line, and which edge-line colors border the right and left sides of divided roads?
sec06-card-sec06-F01.teaching_text: Spotting yellow paint along your right-hand edge at night warns instantly that you are facing traffic the wrong way.

sec06-card-sec06-F02.question_text: How do broken, solid, and double white lane lines differ from yellow center lines in traffic direction and lane-change rules?
sec06-card-sec06-F02.teaching_text: Single solid white discourages lane shifts in hazard zones, whereas double solid white forms a legal wall against crossing.

sec06-card-sec06-F03.question_text: What do double solid yellow lines forbid and allow, and how do mixed solid-and-broken yellow center pairs work?
sec06-card-sec06-F03.teaching_text: Read the stripe closest to your tires: solid yellow on your side locks out passing while allowing left turns.

sec06-card-sec06-F04.question_text: Where do stop lines halt your car, how do ONLY lane arrows differ from mixed arrows, and what is banned in center turn lanes?
sec06-card-sec06-F04.teaching_text: Using a two-way center turn lane as an overtaking lane invites head-on wrecks with drivers entering from ahead.

sec06-card-sec06-F05.question_text: How do reversible rush-hour lanes, solid-white exclusive bike lanes, and painted sharrows each regulate cars and cyclists?
sec06-card-sec06-F05.teaching_text: Drivers must stay out of solid-white bike lanes except to cross over for a turn once cyclists clear.

sec06-card-sec06-F06.question_text: What restrictions match yellow-painted curbs, diagonal pavement stripes, fire lanes, and pedestrian safety zones?
sec06-card-sec06-F06.teaching_text: Diagonal gore stripes shield fixed road hazards, and driving or idling inside fire lanes or safety zones is forbidden.
sec06-card-sec06-F06.must_match_memory_hook: Yellow curbs ban parking, stay clear

visual_sync.text_span: Yellow curbs ban parking, stay clear

sec06-card-sec06-R01.question_text: On a divided Florida highway, which color frames your right road edge and which color frames the left median edge?
sec06-card-sec06-R01.teaching_text: Matching median yellow on your left and shoulder white on your right confirms proper one-way travel.

sec06-card-sec06-R02.question_text: Contrast broken white, single solid white, double solid white, and broken yellow lines on changing lanes or passing?
sec06-card-sec06-R02.teaching_text: Treat single solid white as stay-put advice and double solid white as an absolute barrier between same-way lanes.
sec06-card-sec06-R02.must_match_memory_hook: Broken shifts, solid resists, double walls

visual_sync.text_span: Broken shifts, solid resists, double walls

sec06-card-sec06-R03.question_text: Compare double solid yellow lines against solid-right and broken-right yellow pairs when deciding whether to pass?
sec06-card-sec06-R03.teaching_text: Passing across double solid yellows is restricted to clearing cyclists safely, whereas broken yellow on your right opens normal passing.

sec06-card-sec06-R04.question_text: Pair stop-line placement before crosswalks with ONLY arrows, dual-purpose arrows, and two-way center left-turn lanes?
sec06-card-sec06-R04.teaching_text: Once your tires enter a lane stamped ONLY with a curved arrow, continuing straight through the intersection is illegal.

sec06-card-sec06-R05.question_text: What separates time-flipped reversible lanes, solid-white exclusive bike lanes, and sharrow-marked lanes?
sec06-card-sec06-R05.teaching_text: Overhead lane signals govern reversible commuters, while sharrow chevrons tell drivers and cyclists to share full lane width.
sec06-card-sec06-R05.must_match_memory_hook: Signals flip, white walls, sharrows share

visual_sync.text_span: Signals flip, white walls, sharrows share

sec06-card-sec06-F07.question_text: Which message category belongs to red, orange, yellow, fluorescent yellow-green, black-and-white, green, blue, and brown road signs?
sec06-card-sec06-F07.teaching_text: Reading background color from blocks away lets you prep for construction orange or school fluorescent green before text sharpens.

sec06-card-sec06-F08.question_text: How do green highway signs number east-west versus north-south routes and exits, and what do blue-white and brown-white signs show?
sec06-card-sec06-F08.teaching_text: Exit numbers match highway mile markers in Florida, letting you calculate distance to your off-ramp on the fly.

sec06-card-sec06-F09.question_text: Where exactly must you halt for a stop sign, and how do drivers decide who goes first at an all-way stop?
sec06-card-sec06-F09.teaching_text: Rolling stops fail road tests immediately, and simultaneous arrivals always yield to the driver positioned on the right.

sec06-card-sec06-F10.question_text: Contrast Yield, Do Not Enter, Wrong Way, and red-slash signs, plus Speed Limit, Exit Speed, and doubled-fine zone signs?
sec06-card-sec06-F10.teaching_text: Do Not Enter keeps you out beforehand, whereas spotting Wrong Way means you are already facing oncoming lanes and must turn around.

sec06-card-sec06-F11.question_text: What turning movements do lane-use signs assign, and who gets priority when a right-turn lane crosses a straight bike path?
sec06-card-sec06-F11.teaching_text: When shifting into a dedicated right-turn pocket across a bike lane, straight-riding cyclists keep right-of-way over your merge.

sec06-card-sec06-F12.question_text: Which five turn prohibitions or mandates appear on regulatory signs, and which three channeling signs direct lane position?
sec06-card-sec06-F12.teaching_text: Slower Traffic Keep Right and Keep Right divider plaques prevent left-lane bottlenecks and median strikes.

sec06-card-sec06-F13.question_text: How do regulatory plates govern overtaking zones, reserved transit or bike lanes, highway shoulders, and disabled parking spaces?
sec06-card-sec06-F13.teaching_text: Pulling onto an interstate shoulder just to check texts breaks Emergency Stopping Only rules and invites high-speed strikes.

sec06-card-sec06-R06.question_text: Match all eight Florida road-sign colors cleanly to each color's single sign family?
sec06-card-sec06-R06.teaching_text: Fluorescent yellow-green splits school and pedestrian zones away from standard yellow hazard diamonds.

sec06-card-sec06-R07.question_text: How do green, blue-and-white, and brown-and-white highway signs split navigation, traveler services, and parks?
sec06-card-sec06-R07.teaching_text: Scanning color lets highway drivers spot gas or hospital exits in blue without misreading green city distance boards.
sec06-card-sec06-R07.must_match_memory_hook: Green routes, blue services, brown parks

visual_sync.text_span: Green routes, blue services, brown parks

sec06-card-sec06-R08.question_text: Contrast the exact driver action required by Stop, Yield, Do Not Enter, and Wrong Way signs?
sec06-card-sec06-R08.teaching_text: Yield allows rolling through cautiously when cross traffic is empty, while Stop mandates zero wheel rotation every time.
sec06-card-sec06-R08.must_match_memory_hook: Stop halts, yield slows, turn back

visual_sync.text_span: Stop halts, yield slows, turn back

sec06-card-sec06-R09.question_text: How do main Speed Limit signs, Exit Speed signs, and Speeding Fines Doubled plaques differ?
sec06-card-sec06-R09.teaching_text: Expressway off-ramps tighten sharply, so slowing down to the Exit Speed sign prevents rollover or guardrail skids.
sec06-card-sec06-R09.must_match_memory_hook: Road cap, ramp cap, doubled fines

visual_sync.text_span: Road cap, ramp cap, doubled fines

sec06-card-sec06-R10.question_text: Which specific turns can black-and-white prohibition signs outlaw, and how do one-way or keep-right plaques steer traffic?
sec06-card-sec06-R10.teaching_text: No Turn On Red plaques override the usual stop-and-turn right rule at blind or pedestrian-heavy corners.

sec06-card-sec06-R11.question_text: Summarize how passing signs, reserved-lane signs, and shoulder or bay parking signs divide road space?
sec06-card-sec06-R11.teaching_text: Keeping regular cars out of bus-only lanes, emergency shoulders, and disabled stalls protects transit flow and accessibility.
sec06-card-sec06-R11.must_match_memory_hook: Bans pass, reserves lanes, guards bays

visual_sync.text_span: Bans pass, reserves lanes, guards bays

sec06-card-sec06-F14.question_text: What upcoming controls do advance yellow diamond signs preview, and what do square yellow advisory speed plaques tell you?
sec06-card-sec06-F14.teaching_text: Signal Ahead or Stop Ahead diamonds stop rear-end surprises when trees or hills hide an intersection.
sec06-card-sec06-F14.must_match_memory_hook: Diamonds preview controls, plaques pace curves

visual_sync.text_span: Diamonds preview controls, plaques pace curves

sec06-card-sec06-F15.question_text: Which six layout changes do yellow warning diamonds announce, and how far ahead does Divided Highway Ends warn before two-way traffic?
sec06-card-sec06-F15.teaching_text: Confusing Divided Highway Ahead with Divided Highway Ends is a classic test trap when median protection is disappearing.
sec06-card-sec06-F15.must_match_memory_hook: Divided ends three-fifty to five hundred

visual_sync.text_span: Divided ends three-fifty to five hundred

sec06-card-sec06-F16.question_text: What two rules apply on every bend, sharp turn, S-curve, or winding-road warning, and what do crossroad warnings require?
sec06-card-sec06-F16.teaching_text: Braking before entering the bend keeps tire traction steady, and blind sightlines make passing on curves illegal.

sec06-card-sec06-F17.question_text: Which vehicles, people, and wildlife do crossing warning diamonds flag, and when are animal crossings sharpest?
sec06-card-sec06-F17.teaching_text: Deer and cattle move most around dawn and dusk, turning rural animal-crossing signs into high-alert zones.

sec06-card-sec06-F18.question_text: What hazards do Low Clearance, gravel, Soft Shoulder, Slippery Surface, Dip, Narrow or One-Lane Bridge, and Hill signs warn about?
sec06-card-sec06-F18.teaching_text: Shifting into a lower gear before a steep downgrade spares your brakes from overheating and fading.
sec06-card-sec06-F18.must_match_memory_hook: Check bridge height, gear down hills

visual_sync.text_span: Check bridge height, gear down hills

sec06-card-sec06-R12.question_text: How do advance control-ahead warning signs differ in purpose from yellow advisory speed plaques?
sec06-card-sec06-R12.teaching_text: One prepares your foot to halt or yield ahead, while the small speed tab posts the safe cornering number.
sec06-card-sec06-R12.must_match_memory_hook: Ahead flags stops, advisory paces bends

visual_sync.text_span: Ahead flags stops, advisory paces bends

sec06-card-sec06-R13.question_text: Pair the two universal rules for curve warnings with the exact distance window on a Divided Highway Ends sign?
sec06-card-sec06-R13.teaching_text: Within five hundred feet of that median-ending diamond, opposing headlights return right beside your left fender.

sec06-card-sec06-R14.question_text: Which five groups of cross traffic or wildlife appear on yellow crossing diamonds, and what time of day spikes animal risk?
sec06-card-sec06-R14.teaching_text: Ease off the accelerator near fire-station, truck, or pedestrian diamonds so you can halt cleanly if someone steps out.

sec06-card-sec06-R15.question_text: What exact driver actions match Low Clearance, Slippery Surface, Soft Shoulder, Narrow Bridge, and One-Lane Bridge signs?
sec06-card-sec06-R15.teaching_text: Jerking the wheel or stomping brakes on wet pavement triggers skids, and one-lane spans handle one direction at a time.

sec06-card-sec06-F19.question_text: Who must obey intersection traffic lights, who can override a working signal, and how do you treat a blacked-out traffic light?
sec06-card-sec06-F19.teaching_text: After storms knock out power in Florida, blowing straight through an unlit signal causes T-bone wrecks; stop like a four-way.

sec06-card-sec06-F20.question_text: What rules govern steady red lights and turns on red, steady yellow lights, and steady green lights when traffic backs up?
sec06-card-sec06-F20.teaching_text: Even on a bright green ball, pulling into an intersection without room to clear the far side causes gridlock tickets.
sec06-card-sec06-F20.must_match_memory_hook: Stop on red, never block boxes

visual_sync.text_span: Stop on red, never block boxes

sec06-card-sec06-F21.question_text: How do Florida's steady red arrows, steady yellow arrows, and green arrows regulate turning lanes?
sec06-card-sec06-F21.teaching_text: Notice Florida's state-specific rule: absent a ban sign, steady red arrows allow the same after-stop turns as red balls.
sec06-card-sec06-F21.must_match_memory_hook: Florida red arrows allow legal turns

visual_sync.text_span: Florida red arrows allow legal turns

sec06-card-sec06-F22.question_text: How do a flashing yellow arrow, a flashing red signal, and a flashing yellow signal differ?
sec06-card-sec06-F22.teaching_text: On a flashing yellow arrow, oncoming through traffic holds a green light, so rush-turning cuts straight across live lanes.

sec06-card-sec06-F23.question_text: What do overhead red X, yellow X, and green arrow lane-control signals mean, and how do freeway ramp meters work?
sec06-card-sec06-F23.teaching_text: Overhead red X signals often guard reversible lanes carrying oncoming rush-hour traffic straight toward you.

sec06-card-sec06-R16.question_text: When every bulb at a signalized intersection goes dark and no officer is directing traffic, what rule governs?
sec06-card-sec06-R16.teaching_text: Every approach halts completely first and clears in arrival order with right-side ties unless police wave traffic through.

sec06-card-sec06-R17.question_text: Contrast steady red, steady yellow, and steady green round traffic lights on stopping, turning, and gridlock?
sec06-card-sec06-R17.teaching_text: Speeding up to beat a steady yellow invites intersection T-bones with opposing left-turners clearing the box.
sec06-card-sec06-R17.must_match_memory_hook: Halt red, safe-stop yellow, clear green

visual_sync.text_span: Halt red, safe-stop yellow, clear green

sec06-card-sec06-R18.question_text: How do steady red, yellow, and green turn arrows step through holding, ending, and protected turning?
sec06-card-sec06-R18.teaching_text: Even on a protected green arrow from the proper lane, yield to any pedestrians or vehicles still clearing the box.
sec06-card-sec06-R18.must_match_memory_hook: Hold red, ending yellow, clear green

visual_sync.text_span: Hold red, ending yellow, clear green

sec06-card-sec06-R19.question_text: Keep all three flashing signals straight: flashing yellow arrow, flashing red ball, and flashing yellow ball?
sec06-card-sec06-R19.teaching_text: Drivers facing a flashing red must stop completely, whereas cross traffic often has a flashing yellow and keeps rolling.
sec06-card-sec06-R19.must_match_memory_hook: Yield oncoming, full stop, slow caution

visual_sync.text_span: Yield oncoming, full stop, slow caution

sec06-card-sec06-R20.question_text: Pair overhead red X, yellow X, and green arrow lane signals with expressway ramp-meter signals?
sec06-card-sec06-R20.teaching_text: Move safely out of a yellow-X lane before it flips to a prohibited red X, and wait for green on metered ramps.
sec06-card-sec06-R20.must_match_memory_hook: Exit yellow X, wait ramp green

visual_sync.text_span: Exit yellow X, wait ramp green

sec06-card-sec06-F24.question_text: How do orange signs, diagonal channelizer stripes, flashing arrow boards, and vested flaggers guide you through construction zones?
sec06-card-sec06-F24.teaching_text: Diagonal stripes on barricades slope downward toward the safe side you must pass on, and flagger directions carry legal force.

sec06-card-sec06-F25.question_text: At a Florida drawbridge, what do steady red, steady yellow, and steady green bridge signals each mean?
sec06-card-sec06-F25.teaching_text: Waterway spans open frequently across coastal Florida, so steady yellow means halt safely before bridge locks disengage.

sec06-card-sec06-F26.question_text: What must you do at a flashing yellow drawbridge beacon versus a flashing red signal with bells and gates?
sec06-card-sec06-F26.teaching_text: Zigzagging around a lowered or rising drawbridge gate risks plunging off an opening span deck.

sec06-card-sec06-F27.question_text: How do WALK symbols, steady or flashing raised hands, countdown timers, and push-button crosswalk beacons work?
sec06-card-sec06-F27.teaching_text: Pedestrians already in the street finish during a countdown, yet stepping off the curb after the hand flashes is prohibited.

sec06-card-sec06-F28.question_text: Walk through all five stages of a Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon from dark to flashing red?
sec06-card-sec06-F28.teaching_text: Once the beacon shifts from steady red to alternating wig-wag flashing red, drivers stop and may proceed if walkers cleared.

sec06-card-sec06-R21.question_text: Name the four visual and human controls that steer traffic safely through Florida work zones?
sec06-card-sec06-R21.teaching_text: Flaggers override standard signs when shifting lanes around live road crews, so drop speed as soon as orange appears.

sec06-card-sec06-R22.question_text: Contrast steady red, steady yellow, and steady green signals at a movable drawbridge?
sec06-card-sec06-R22.teaching_text: Never accelerate to beat a yellowing drawbridge signal right before warning gates drop.
sec06-card-sec06-R22.must_match_memory_hook: Span open, span closing, cautious go

visual_sync.text_span: Span open, span closing, cautious go

sec06-card-sec06-R23.question_text: Tie together drawbridge gate bans, pedestrian hand and countdown rules, and activated crosswalk beacons?
sec06-card-sec06-R23.teaching_text: Both lowered bridge arms and pedestrian-triggered flashing beacons demand complete driver compliance.
sec06-card-sec06-R23.must_match_memory_hook: Zero gate bypass, stop on beacons

visual_sync.text_span: Zero gate bypass, stop on beacons

sec06-card-sec06-R24.question_text: In exact order, what are the five light stages a driver sees on a Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon?
sec06-card-sec06-R24.teaching_text: Knowing that flashing red acts like a stop-and-go-when-clear phase prevents stalling traffic after pedestrians reach the curb.

sec06-card-sec06-F29.question_text: Within how many feet of railroad tracks is parking banned, and what four cues force a complete stop at a crossing?
sec06-card-sec06-F29.teaching_text: Trains overhang wider than steel rails, so parking inside fifteen feet puts your car inside the locomotive strike envelope.
sec06-card-sec06-F29.must_match_memory_hook: Fifteen-foot park ban, four stop cues

visual_sync.text_span: Fifteen-foot park ban, four stop cues

sec06-card-sec06-F30.question_text: What do round advance signs, white crossbucks with track plaques, flashing red lights, gates, stop lines, and painted X boxes each do?
sec06-card-sec06-F30.teaching_text: Always check the number plaque beneath the crossbuck so a second train on parallel tracks never surprises you.

sec06-card-sec06-F31.question_text: Why must you watch buses and hazmat trucks at crossings, check far-side space, and wait until all tracks clear?
sec06-card-sec06-F31.teaching_text: Starting across tracks when traffic ahead cannot fit your bumper beyond the far rail traps you on live steel.
sec06-card-sec06-F31.must_match_memory_hook: Fit past rails, watch stopping buses

sec06-card-sec06-F32.question_text: What four habits do school-zone signs require around children, crossing guards, active zone limits, and school buses?
sec06-card-sec06-F32.teaching_text: Speeding fines double during active school-zone hours, and children dart unpredictably around stopped buses and crosswalks.
sec06-card-sec06-F32.must_match_memory_hook: Obey crossing guards, honor zone speeds

visual_sync.text_span: Obey crossing guards, honor zone speeds

sec06-card-sec06-R25.question_text: List the four railroad crossing triggers that require halting and the exact no-parking distance from steel rails?
sec06-card-sec06-R25.teaching_text: Never stop on the rails themselves or park inside fifteen feet when waiting for signals, gates, flaggers, or trains.

sec06-card-sec06-R26.question_text: Why must you expect buses or tankers to stop at open crossings and confirm full vehicle space past the far rail?
sec06-card-sec06-R26.teaching_text: School buses and hazmat haulers must halt at tracks even when red lights stay dark and gates stay upright.
sec06-card-sec06-R26.must_match_memory_hook: Expect mandatory stops, clear far rail

visual_sync.text_span: Expect mandatory stops, clear far rail

sec06-card-sec06-R27.question_text: Summarize the four continuous duties Florida school-zone signs place on every passing driver?
sec06-card-sec06-R27.teaching_text: Stay alert until you pass the End School Zone plaque, watching for hidden school-bus stops ahead.
sec06-card-sec06-R27.must_match_memory_hook: Scan kids, slow crossings, obey zones
